title: Situational Awareness
description: Dated claims from Leopold Aschenbrenner’s 2024 scenario about AGI, compute build-out, automated research, and superintelligence.

version.label: June 2024 published series
version.notes: Calendar anchors are a reviewed presentation of the dated scenario in Situational Awareness: The Decade Ahead.

milestones.title: AI systems surpass most college graduates
milestones.summary: AI systems become smarter than most college graduates.
milestones.source_context: Introduction and From GPT-4 to AGI
milestones.normalization_rationale: The source gives a two-year window; its midpoint is December 31, 2025.
milestones.uncertainty: The source frames the broader AGI timeline as strikingly plausible rather than certain.

milestones.title: One hundred million automated junior coders
milestones.summary: Automated systems provide the equivalent of roughly one hundred million junior software engineers.
milestones.normalization_rationale: The 12-to-24-month range from the June 4, 2024 publication is anchored at its 18-month midpoint.
milestones.uncertainty: This is a scale illustration within the intelligence-explosion argument.

milestones.title: Million-GPU training cluster
milestones.summary: The largest training cluster reaches roughly one million H100-equivalent GPUs, about $10 billion and 1 GW.
milestones.normalization_rationale: The source names approximately 2026; July 1 is the representative year midpoint.
milestones.uncertainty: Hardware counts, cost, and power are order-of-magnitude projections.

milestones.title: Leading AI companies approach $100B revenue run rate
milestones.summary: Leading AI companies approach a combined annualized revenue scale of roughly $100 billion.
milestones.normalization_rationale: The source uses a mid-2026 illustrative doubling trajectory; July 1 anchors midyear.
milestones.uncertainty: The projection extrapolates a revenue-doubling trajectory and is not a company guarantee.

milestones.title: AGI becomes strikingly plausible
milestones.summary: Models capable of doing the work of AI researchers and engineers make AGI plausible around 2027.
milestones.source_context: Introduction and From GPT-4 to AGI
milestones.normalization_rationale: The source names 2027; July 1 is the representative year midpoint.
milestones.uncertainty: The author calls the date a best guess/modal year and emphasizes uncertainty.

milestones.title: First $10 trillion company
milestones.summary: AI-driven revenue growth supports the first company reaching a $10 trillion valuation.
milestones.normalization_rationale: The source spans 2026–2027; January 1, 2027 is the midpoint boundary.
milestones.uncertainty: A market-capitalization extrapolation, not a certainty.

milestones.title: Annual AI investment exceeds $1 trillion
milestones.summary: Total annual AI investment rises above $1 trillion, roughly three percent of US GDP.
milestones.normalization_rationale: The source names 2027; July 1 is the representative year midpoint.
milestones.uncertainty: The estimate extrapolates investment growth and uses approximate magnitudes.

milestones.title: Government AGI project begins
milestones.summary: The US government creates a national AGI effort resembling a modern Manhattan Project.
milestones.normalization_rationale: The 2027–2028 range is anchored at the January 1, 2028 midpoint boundary.
milestones.uncertainty: The exact institutional form is explicitly uncertain.

milestones.title: Ten-million-GPU training cluster
milestones.summary: The largest training cluster reaches roughly ten million H100-equivalent GPUs, about $100 billion and 10 GW.
milestones.normalization_rationale: The source names approximately 2028; July 1 is the representative year midpoint.
milestones.uncertainty: Hardware counts, cost, and power are order-of-magnitude projections.

milestones.title: Prototype automated AI researcher
milestones.summary: A prototype automated researcher can increasingly automate AI research itself.
milestones.normalization_rationale: The 2027–2028 range is anchored at the January 1, 2028 midpoint boundary.
milestones.uncertainty: The source presents multiple possible timelines for the transition.

milestones.title: Rapid intelligence explosion reaches superintelligence
milestones.summary: Automated AI research drives a rapid transition from AGI toward superintelligence.
milestones.source_context: From AGI to Superintelligence and The Project
milestones.normalization_rationale: The 2028–2029 range is anchored at the January 1, 2029 midpoint boundary.
milestones.uncertainty: Timing depends on AGI arriving and recursive research automation working.

milestones.title: Hundreds of millions of GPUs support AI
milestones.summary: Hundreds of millions of GPUs support AI systems by the end of the 2020s.
milestones.source_context: Introduction and From AGI to Superintelligence
milestones.normalization_rationale: “By the end of the decade” is anchored to December 31, 2029.
milestones.uncertainty: The quantity is an order-of-magnitude projection.

milestones.title: Trillion-dollar, 100-GW training cluster
milestones.summary: A frontier training cluster reaches roughly one hundred million H100-equivalent GPUs, more than $1 trillion and 100 GW.
milestones.normalization_rationale: The source names approximately 2030; July 1 is the representative year midpoint.
milestones.uncertainty: The projection may face power, chip, finance, and permitting constraints.

milestones.title: Superintelligence reshapes the world
milestones.summary: By 2030 the scenario has summoned superintelligence and entered a period of extraordinary upheaval.
milestones.normalization_rationale: The source names 2030; July 1 is the representative year midpoint.
milestones.uncertainty: This culmination is conditional on the preceding capability and governance sequence.
